steps.name: Ceobe?
steps.text: (Howl of anger)

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: What magic should I use here... It feels like no matter what I go for, it'll hurt Kay—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Please, help me keep her still! I'll calm her down!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Easy for you to say, but she's being a real terror without a leash!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Senshi, do we still have any of that popcorn left over?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Aye.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Try throwing some of it for her to eat!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Got it!
Before he even finishes speaking, Senshi reaches into his sack for a ball of popcorn and lobs it at Ceobe.
Ceobe stares at it as if entranced, her anger placated.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: I knew it! She's looking for something to eat!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Maybe something she ate on her journey upset her stomach and made her this way!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Since when do people turn into monsters when they get a stomachache?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit once told me that Kay comes from a special bloodline, so that might actually be possible.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Are you serious?!

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Save the talk for later! Let's get her under control while she's distracted!

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: You, with the sword! You, with the pot on your back! You two look strong; let's hold her down together.

steps.name: Laios & Senshi
steps.text: Right!
The three of them sneak behind Ceobe while she happily munches on popcorn. With all their might, they each grab one of her legs firmly.

steps.name: Ceobe?
steps.text: (Unhappy howling)

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Now, Amiya!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Got it!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Come back to us, Kay.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Don't be scared. You're safe at home right now.

steps.name: Ceobe?
steps.text: (Pained howl)

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Amazing... I've never seen magic like that before.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Look, Kay's back!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh, thank goodness!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Kay! are you alright?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Hmm...? Wha... what happened...?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: It's like I was... dreaming!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Dreaming?!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Yeah...
Ceobe looks around her. The once neat-and-tidy room is now in utter shambles. Her hand is still curled around half a broken toy.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: I'm sorry... Vulcan told me if I do something bad, I have to say sorry, and it looks like I did something bad...

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: I was real hungry in my dream, and my tummy kept rumbling... and then...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And then...?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: And then I grew lots of heads, and I wanted to eat a whole bunch of things!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: All I had to do was eat until I was full, then I'd be real happy, and I'd come back here!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (Whispers) Matterhorn, where's Vulcan? Has she noticed anything about Kay recently?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: (Whispers) I'll go ask her once we're done here.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: (Whispers) So, what should we do with her now?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: ...*rumble*...

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Oh? Hungry again?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Yep!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: I wanna eat lots and lots!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: I was full in my dream, but now I'm hungry again!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Kay, do you know of a monster with three heads?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Of course I know!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: What do you know about it?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: It doesn't just have three heads, it's got a thousand!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Every time I wanna eat lots and lots, I grow ten, a hundred... no, a thousand heads! That's why I can never get enough!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: I've got a thousand heads!

steps.name: Laios's Party
steps.text: You what?!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Well, as long as my tummy's full, I won't become like how I was just now!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Well then! I'll cook you up a proper meal right away!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We'll make an exception to the 'no snacks before a meal' rule. We do need to bring her in for a medical exam, though.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Now, friends from afar, why don't you take a stroll around Rhodes Island? This might be a bit much to ask, but I was hoping you could show off your cooking skills once more at mealtime.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: S-Sure, thanks...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: As for the other reason you sought us out...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We might need some time to know your circumstances before we can figure out how to get you home.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Oh... So, what do we do now?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I wouldn't worry too much. The Doctor and Dr. Kal'tsit might be able to find a way.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Really?!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes. Whatever the case, you did help Kay, and your situation is... rather peculiar.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If you like, you can stay on Rhodes Island for a while.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: As our representative, allow me to welcome you all aboard.

steps.name: Curious Operator A
steps.text: More newbies? Which department are they under?

steps.name: Curious Operator B
steps.text: Weird, can't tell what race they are. They hiding their tails or something?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: I saw a young lady carrying a whole lot of crops just now. Mind showing me your farms here?

steps.name: Curious Operator A
steps.text: Farms... Do you mean Horticulture and Hydroponics, that kind of thing? Follow me.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: You guys got an inn here?

steps.name: Curious Operator B
steps.text: Oh, so you're a Durin! C'mon, it's this way.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Do you... do you have anywhere I could take a proper bath and comb my hair?

steps.name: Curious Operator C
steps.text: Of course, dear, the dorms have all you need. Just follow me!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Oh, such long rabbit ears! I wasn't able to get a good look at their capillary distribution last time. What a shame...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Wow, they can adjust the position of their tails to maintain their balance. Ingenious...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Hmm... Some clearly have feathers, but they have no wings. Can they fly?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Ah, this place really is heaven...

steps.name: Curious Operator D
steps.text: Oh, isn't he one of the new operators they were talking about? He looks a bit lost, standing in the middle of the corridor like that. Do you think he's too embarrassed to ask for directions?

steps.name: Curious Operator E
steps.text: Maybe he's a bit shy. Why don't we start the conversation?

steps.name: Curious Operator E
steps.text: Hello! Do you happen to be—

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: (Whispers) Do these birdmen lay eggs? If they're unfertilized, then can I see how one tastes? With this many people on board, surely I can get a few...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: (Whispers) Can goatman hair be knitted into sweaters? The ones I saw earlier had bare arms though, doesn't seem like they grow wool. A shame...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: (Whispers) But what I really want to know is, if a catman and a dogman have a child, would they be a cat or a dog? Or maybe they're half-cat half-dog? ...Maybe the top is a cat and the bottom is a dog? Or maybe it's split left and right instead?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: (Whispers) ...What if it's with a birdman? Would they lay an egg that hatches into a cat? Hmm...

steps.name: Curious Operators
steps.text: Yeah...

steps.name: Curious Operators
steps.text: Uh...

steps.name: Curious Operators
steps.text: (Collectively step back)

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Oh, hello.

steps.name: Curious Operators
steps.text: (Collectively take another step back)

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Can I ask you a question...

steps.name: Curious Operators
steps.text: (Collectively take yet another step back)

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Do you lay eggs?

options: He wasn't asking you, Mon3tr. No need to come out.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Hmm? Oh! Sorry, I was asking those bird—err, Liberi... Huh? Where'd they go?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Why's everyone standing so far away from me?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hmm?

steps.name: No-Longer-Curious Operator D
steps.text: Amiya! That's him! That's the guy I was telling you about!

steps.name: No-Longer-Curious Operator E
steps.text: He's no patient, he's one of those... 'guests' we found waking up on the deck!

steps.name: No-Longer-Curious Operator F
steps.text: He-he-he's been asking us all sorts of dreadful questions, over and over again!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ah... What sort of questions?

steps.name: No-Longer-Curious Operator D
steps.text: He asked us if our children would be half-cat half-dog!

steps.name: No-Longer-Curious Operator E
steps.text: He asked if Liberi could lay eggs, and if he could eat them!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Hiss)

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Oh, my, what a magnificent one. You're called Mon3tr, right?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Can I touch you?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Piercing cry)

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Nimble motion)

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Wh-Whoa?!

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Wow! How do you keep your hair so golden and shiny when you spend most of your time in a dangerous dungeon? Without any good haircare either!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Heheh! It's all because of how important hair is to a magician. I store some of my mana in it.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Here. This is one of my favorite hair creams. It has perfume and herbal extracts mixed in, and it'll keep your hair moisturized and protected.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: The only reason my hair is as sleek as it is now is thanks to frequent application!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Wow, it smells great!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: If you'd like a change of pace in your hairstyle, I've got lots of braiding tips I can show you!
Where. Do. You. Think. You're. Going?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: I was just—

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Whoa!
What were you doing with my flames?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Uh...
I said, what were you doing with my flames?!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: ...Roasting some chestnuts...

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Roasting.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Some.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Chestnuts!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Roasting some chestnuts.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: The lass driving the tractor gave me a bushel of raw ones, said they were the first harvest of chestnuts she managed to grow on Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: You manage your farms well. Chestnuts make a mighty fine snack. They get soft and sweet after roasting, and their shells become easy to peel too.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Pity the fire coming off your body was too hot! Ended up burning 'em all. I said I'd cook a meal for you, but I never expected to waste perfectly good ingredients like that. Real shameful behavior, if you ask me...

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: Skyfire, please calm down!

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: Ahh! Shaw, Shaw! Come quick! Skyfire's catching fire again!

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: Mister, please don't cook anything else on her, especially not those kebabs!

spans.text: don't cook anything else on her,

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: *gulp*!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Not half bad.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Phew. Anyway, like I said, I'm not a Durin.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Wait, you're not?

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: You're not a child then, are you?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Mind sitting down when we talk? I can't see your face.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: I am sitting down.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Care for another?

steps.name: SilverAsh
steps.text: My thanks.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Are all the men here this tall? Even Laios seems a bit short compared to you guys...

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: (Whispers) This guy covered in silvery-white hair... If Laios saw him, I bet the only thing he'd be thinking about is asking him if he'd like some help combing it all...

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Ah, whatever.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: A drinking party? Without me?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I know it's been a while, but did all of you really forget to ask me?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hmm? Hey, what's with the kid? Kids shouldn't be drinking.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Uhh...

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: *gulp*

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: *sniffsniffsniff*

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: (Something smells really good!)

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: (Maybe they finished cooking?)

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: (Tasty food's here!!)

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Let's gooooo!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: My back—

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: (Uh-oh, I hit someone...)

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Sorry!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Vulcan told me if I ran into someone, I have to say sorry.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Sorry, Mister Beard! I ran into you 'cause I was hungry!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: It's fine, come help me put it all on the table!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: A meal made with the ingredients and memories given to us by the folks we met along the way. 'Tis done!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Come have a bite. Do they all taste like they did before?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Hmm... I wanted to ask earlier while we were preparing the ingredients, but why are we making the exact same dishes we had on our journey?

spans.text: Hmm... I wanted to ask earlier while we were preparing the ingredients, but why
we making the exact same dishes we had on our journey?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Does repeating the same recipe make you feel better?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: ...That, I can't say for sure. But if it's got the same taste, then I'll think back to the first time I had it, and what was going through my mind at the time.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Like if I said 'scorpion hotpot,' what's the first thought that comes to mind, Marcille?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: ...The first time I met you in the Beginners' Plaza.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Walking mushroom feet are both edible and tasty, with a unique aroma.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Scorpions are a pain to cut into bits.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: What about that basilisk?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: You saying you had to cook the antidote herb with the chicken for that adventurer so it'd taste better...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Basilisks are really cool!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Marcille finally getting to eat that chicken she was craving.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Then, mandrake?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Very unique heads!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Marcille and that big bat—

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: We can skip over that one, okay?!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: See? That's what I mean.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Food is connected to memory. When you eat something you've had before, your brain automatically goes back to the other times you've had it.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: It's the same when I cook. I think of the people I first made the dish with. Why did we choose to make it? Did we learn anything new while preparing the ingredients? Any happy smiles after we were done eating?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: This way, the aroma and flavor can recreate the scene in your mind, bit by bit.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: As for the meal we're about to have? That gets to be a new memory, to be brought up during future dinners.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Wow...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: You've always had a way with words, Senshi.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Alright, enough prattle! Let's eat!

steps.name: Overjoyed Laios's Party
steps.text: Chow time!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mmm. These carrots are perfect! Would you like to try some, Doctor?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Are you sure you don't want any roast Originium slug? Really? It's delicious.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Not even one shell?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Wow... Can I really eat this?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Of course!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: All of it?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: All of it!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Yippee! You are so kind!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Oh, right... 'Doctor,' was it? Just noticed you there.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: While we were cooking, the operators told me you're often so busy with work that you forget to eat.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: And when you do remember, it's some hastily-thrown-together slop, on top of unhealthy wake-me-ups or empty calories just to fill your stomach.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Hardly what I'd call a good attitude to health! There's plenty of people worried about you!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Doctor, if you want to get strong, you need a good work-life balance, to eat three square meals a day, and to get some exercise! Got that?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Thanks for helping us out, Doctor. The same goes to everyone at Rhodes Island. I've made a lot of new friends here.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: If only Falin were here too...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: After we're done eating, could you give us a detailed overview of this land?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: What? Why're you staring at me, Doctor? What, you want a drink? Well, it's not that you can't, it's just... Are you an adult yet?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: I really can't tell with that mask on...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Oh, this is delicious!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: I need to note down the recipe. We've got to make it for Falin once we save her!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: I'll have to tell her all about the journey we went on to save her, about all the lovely people we met along the way, and all the memories we made...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: I'm sure she'll love hearing about it!
